severity_source_of_truth: The export's highest_severity is the maximum across thirteen dimensions and direct, indirect, and inferred channels. The public highestSeverityScore uses a broad aggregate too: the incident detail's direct-only label is misleading. The live mirror can assign different scores and labels to the same records. Representative interactive checks in the in-app browser and Safari reproduced the label problem and ineffective timeline severe-harm preset. No global classification accuracy is established.
chart_caveat: Representative controls, charts and incident details were exercised in the in-app browser and native Safari on September 27–28, 2026. Exact coverage and exclusions are recorded in review/browser/BROWSER_CHECKS.md. The live mirror differs from the supplied CSV even when both contain 1,698 records; a compatible chart configuration does not guarantee identical live figures. C04 exposes nine grouping dimensions plus None, while C03 exposes thirteen dimensions.
